verdict.rationale: Clerky's own documentation says document sets bundle documents and signatures and that users sign documents on Clerky, so signing exists inside its templated legal workflows. Inviting collaborators to a document set is also documented. Nothing shows sending an arbitrary document to several signers with signing order or routing. Missing for 10: sending arbitrary or uploaded documents for signature, multi-recipient signer assignment, routing or signing-order controls, evidence of legally binding e-signature compliance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the signing flow.
